linux.command: mkdir -p assets/img && for f in assets/raw/*.{jpg,jpeg,png,JPG,JPEG,PNG}; do [ -e "$f" ] || continue; name=$(basename "${f%.*}"); magick "$f" -resize 400x -quality 80 "assets/img/${name}-mobile.jpg"; magick "$f" -resize 1000x -quality 85 "assets/img/${name}-desktop.jpg"; done && echo 'Imágenes optimizadas correctamente en assets/img/'

osx.command: mkdir -p assets/img && for f in assets/raw/*.{jpg,jpeg,png,JPG,JPEG,PNG}; do [ -e "$f" ] || continue; name=$(basename "${f%.*}"); magick "$f" -resize 400x -quality 80 "assets/img/${name}-mobile.jpg"; magick "$f" -resize 1000x -quality 85 "assets/img/${name}-desktop.jpg"; done && echo 'Imágenes optimizadas correctamente en assets/img/'

windows.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path 'assets/img' | Out-Null; Get-ChildItem 'assets/raw' -Include *.jpg,*.jpeg,*.png -Recurse | ForEach-Object { $name = $_.BaseName; magick $_.FullName -resize 400x -quality 80 "assets/img/$name-mobile.jpg"; magick $_.FullName -resize 1000x -quality 85 "assets/img/$name-desktop.jpg" }; Write-Host 'Imágenes optimizadas correctamente en assets/img/'"
